arguments.code: async ({ shell: { exec } }) => exec("sleep 15; id=$(gh run list --workflow release.yml --limit 1 --json databaseId -q '.[0].databaseId'); gh run watch $id --exit-status >/dev/null 2>&1; echo exit=$?; gh run view $id --json conclusion,headBranch -q '.headBranch+\" \"+.conclusion'; gh release list --limit 2; git ls-remote origin refs/tags/v2 'refs/tags/v2^{}'; git rev-parse origin/main", { timeoutMs: 290000 })
arguments.label: Watch release workflow and check draft release
